title: Senior Product Designer
description:
**Heja is on a mission** to unite 1.5 billion people through youth sports. We believe organized sports have a real impact on children’s health. In a few years, we've grown to over 7 million users in 50+ countries, mainly from the US, UK, New Zealand, and Australia. Thousands more are joining every day to meet, unite and develop - together.

**As a Senior Product Designer,** you’ll play a key role in shaping the Heja experience. You’ll be responsible for the overall design direction, creating a consistent UI and UX across the product, and helping define how design works as our team grows. You’ll work closely with product managers, engineers, and leadership to turn complex problems into simple, thoughtful, and high-quality experiences.


You’ll join a curious, open-minded, and self-governing team built on honesty, trust, and high ambition. We’re a stable, profitable, and growing Swedish product driven company with a global mission, and we’re looking for people who care deeply about solving meaningful problems to help us take the next step.

### **In this position, you will...**

* Lead end-to-end design for new and existing product areas, from discovery, rapid prototyping, and early interaction ideas to polished flows ready for implementation.
* Build and evolve Heja’s design system, creating a more consistent UI and product experience across the full customer journey.
* Explore how AI can improve both the Heja product experience and the way we design, test ideas, learn, and build great products.
* Contribute to product direction by bringing a strong design perspective into regular discussions around user needs, product strategy, and design language with the rest of the team.
* Work closely with Product Managers and Engineers to ensure high-quality design implementation from idea to shipped product.
* Use research, data, product intuition, and customer insights to identify opportunities and make strong design decisions.

### **The role is perfect for you if...**

* You have strong expertise in UI & UX Design for digital products.
* You have an eye for detail and can express ideas through world-class visuals.
* Passion for design, digital products, and preferably branding.
* Ability to think through and outline complex interaction design.
* You are comfortable moving between strategic product thinking and hands-on execution.
* You are curious about AI and how it can be used to improve both product experiences and the way teams work.
* You are fluent in English (Swedish is a plus but not required).

*If you're excited, please apply even if you don't check all the "boxes" above.*

### **Recruitment process**


We'd love to see your portfolio - make sure to attach it to your application.

* **Introduction and culture interview.** We'll get to know each other better.
* **Case.** We'll send you a case where you get to be creative.
* **Competence interview.** Case presentation and we'll deep dive more into your design skills and values.
* **Culture interview.** Final interview around discussing values and culture.

*We value diversity of perspective and seek to build an inclusive workplace that welcomes people from all different backgrounds.*

title: Senior Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
We are a people company. Our experienced, skilled and passionate people empower customers and partners to meet their challenges through best-in-class, user-friendly solutions. And we are a technology company. We help our customers and partners optimize processes through our software, hardware and services and through our support. Connecting people and technologies provide the means to accomplish goals and ambitions and gain a competitive edge in today’s digitalized world.

##### **The opportunity**


We are looking for a skilled Senior QA Engineer to join our R&D organization and the IX product team. The team is responsible for the IX Developer, a development environment which is used by our customers to create applications with great UX, allowing end-users to control any industry process.


As a Senior QA engineer, you share the responsibility, both for the day-to-day QA work and the strategic perspective of how we work with quality long-term. If you have an interest in QA best practices like test automation and test strategies, this role will give you the opportunity to put theory into practice.


The doors are open; we welcome you to join our R&D organization! This is for sure where the magic happens. It consists of several product teams working in the areas of software, hardware, and mechanics.

##### **The successful applicant**


We’re looking for an open-minded engineer who enjoys learning new things. At Beijer, we work with many different systems and tools, and we think that you are comfortable to quickly adapt to different development environments and setups.


You will be the voice of the user in terms of quality. That's why drive and good communication skills are important to be able to share your view of the product.

###### **The must-have list**

* Hands-on experience in testing software and/or automation systems
* Hands-on experience of risk-based testing
* Practical experience in test automation
* Understanding the importance of non-functional requirements (performance, stability, etc)
* Great skills in English, both written and verbal
* Possibility to work on-site from the Malmö office at least three days per week

###### **The bonus list**

* Understanding of the automation domain (PLC, HMI, communication)
* Experience of testing embedded systems
* Software development skills
* Knowledge of security testing
* DevOps experience
* Knowledge of agile methodologies
* Coaching skills

##### **Are you up for the challenge?**


Don’t wait, submit your application sooner rather than later.


Looking forward to hearing from you!  



*Beijer Electronics is a multinational, cross-industry innovator that connects people and technologies to optimize processes for business-critical applications. Our offer includes operator communication, automation solutions, digitalization, display solutions and support. As experts in user-friendly software, hardware and services for the Industrial Internet of Things, we empower our customers to meet their challenges through leading-edge solutions.*

title: Product Designer
description:
**TL;DR** 
 - We’re looking for world-class product designers to help shape Lovable. You’ll lead projects end-to-end, collaborating closely with engineering. We expect a broad range of design skills, and exceptional taste. You’ll join a team at the forefront of AI, enabling anyone to create software.
   

  

**Why Lovable?**
 Lovable lets anyone and everyone build software with any language. From solopreneurs to Fortune 100 teams, millions of people use Lovable to transform raw ideas into real products - fast. We are at the forefront of a foundational shift in software creation, which means you have an unprecedented opportunity to change the way the digital world works. Lovable-built applications and websites are visited hundreds of millions of times a month, and our enterprise footprint is compounding fast. And we’re just getting started.
   

  

 We’re a small, talent-dense team building a generation-defining company from Stockholm. We value extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We seek out people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
   

  

**What We’re Looking For**
* A track record of working in high performing, fast-paced startup environments
* A portfolio showcasing successful product work loved by users and produced in high-velocity teams
* Talent for simplifying complicated user journeys into intuitive experiences
* Strong prototyping abilities with emphasis on clear visual communication
* Fluency with design systems and technical implementations
* Outstanding command of visual design, UI patterns, and interaction principles
* High aptitude for shipping and learning extraordinarily quickly
* Bonus: You ship to production, perhaps with a little help from AI
* Bonus: Experience designing AI products


**What You’ll Do**
**In one sentence:** 
 Design Lovable, making it the most Lovable piece of software ever.
   

  

* Craft detailed user flows and high-fidelity mockups for new features
* Own design projects from conception to delivery, collaborating with engineering or ideally implementing yourself with AI (we'll train you)
* Be scrappy and hands on with any design assets needed
* Establish scalable design processes that uphold quality standards
* Champion quick wins and impactful improvements
* Contribute to improving the design quality of Lovable's AI
* Help set the bar for design quality and the culture for how design works at Lovable


**How We Hire**
* Fill in a short form then jump on an initial exploratory call.
* We'll send you a quick take-home asking to present your best work over a loom video presentation.
* Join us for a round of interviews to discuss your experience in more depth
* Join us for trial work lasting 1-2 days remote or on-site. We'll see how you tick and you get to meet the team and explore whether joining Lovable feels right for you.


**Important Note** 
 :
   

  

* Please submit your application in English. It’s our company language so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join.
* We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested please apply through our careers portal.

title: UX Designer inom sparande
description:
*Har du ett brinnande intresse för sparande, vill jobba brett inom hela spara området och vill vara med och forma framtidens sparupplevelse? Vi befinner oss i en spännande fas där vi satsar på att förbättra den digitala kundupplevelsen inom sparande. Det innebär att du hos oss inte bara vidareutvecklar befintliga lösningar – du är också med och bygger upp något nytt, och verkligen kan göra skillnad. Hjärtligt välkommen till Skandia* 
 ! 💚
   

  

**Att jobba som UX Designer inom sparande**
 Som UX Designer hos oss blir du en del av ett tvärfunktionellt team där du arbetar nära produktägare, utvecklare och specialister inom sparande. Du ansvarar för UX-arbetet från idé till färdig lösning och har en central roll i att skapa intuitiva och användbara tjänster.
   

  

**I Rollen Kommer Du Bland Annat Att**
* Driva UX-arbetet end-to-end – från behovsbild till utvecklingsklar design
* Ta fram wireframes, flöden och prototyper i Figma
* Omvandla komplexa regelverk, affärskrav och kundbehov till enkla och tydliga lösningar, färdiga att realiseras
* Säkerställa att designen är intuitiv och ligger i linje med hur sparlösningar förväntas fungera
* Samarbeta nära UX Lead och UX-kollegor inom bank, försäkring och pension för att skapa en sammanhållen kundupplevelse
* Bidra till utvecklingen av designprinciper och förbättring av befintligt designsystem


 Du kommer vara med och arbeta med hela sparresan – inte bara en del av den – vilket ger en bredd som ger verklig chans att förbättra kundupplevelsen.
   

  

**För att lyckas i rollen**
 Vi söker dig som har;
   

  

* En gedigen erfarenhet i rollen som UX Designer, gärna inom både web och app
* Erfarenhet av att driva UX-arbete självständigt från research till implementation
* Mycket god erfarenhet av Figma
* Erfarenhet av att designa lösningar som är redo för utveckling (hands-on, leveransfokus)
* God kommunikativ förmåga i svenska, både i tal och skrift
* Erfarenhet av UX arbete inom sparande (aktier, fonder, värdepapper) eller ett starkt och genuint privat intresse för sparande och investeringar


 Meriterande erfarenhet;
   

  

* Erfarenhet från bank, fintech eller annan regelverksstyrd verksamhet
* Erfarenhet av att arbeta med eller påverka designsystem
* Erfarenhet av datadriven design och uppföljning av lösningar
* Van att arbeta i större organisationer med flera intressenter


 För att trivas och lyckas i rollen ser vi att du är en person som drivs av att få saker gjorda och skapa konkreta resultat. Du har en stark vilja att leverera och tycker om att omsätta idéer till fungerande lösningar i praktiken.
   

  

 Du är trygg i din kompetens och kan stå för dina designbeslut, samtidigt som du har förmågan att pedagogiskt förklara och förankra dem i dialog med andra. I en organisation med många kontaktytor är det viktigt att du kan navigera olika perspektiv och vågar vara en tydlig röst i gemensamma forum.
   

  

 Vi tror också att du har en naturlig nyfikenhet – både kring kundbeteenden och sparande som område – och att du drivs av att förstå hur man skapar användarupplevelser som faktiskt gör skillnad för kunden.
   

  

**Vad händer nu?**
 Vi arbetar med löpande urval, så skicka gärna in din ansökan redan idag, men i och med stundande semestertider tar vi ett uppehåll i rekryteringsprocessen och
 **återupptar urval och intervjuerna i mitten av augusti** 
 . Varmt välkommen med din ansökan, och trevlig sommar! 🌞Utöver CV vill vi att du bifogar din designportfölj!
   

  

 Om du har frågor kring rollen, vänligen kontakta rekryterande chef Ulf Ahrner på ulf.ahrner@skandia.se.
   

  

 Om har frågor kopplat till rekryteringsprocess, vänligen kontakta Susanne Hedberg på susanne.hedberg@skandia.se.
   

  

 Vi kommer att återkoppla till alla som söker oavsett om du går vidare eller inte.
   

  

**Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!**
 I den här processen har vi följande steg;
   

  

* Kortare avstämningsintervju
* Verksamhetsintervju
* Design Case
* Teamintervju
* Logik- och personlighetstest
* Slutdiskussion
* Bakgrundskontroll
* Referenstagning


**Mer om Banken**
 Vi har varit pionjärer inom digital bankverksamhet sedan starten 1994, som Sveriges första helt digitala bank. Med en passion för innovation och kundfokus har vi vuxit till att erbjuda ett brett utbud av produkter och tjänster inom områdena Låna, Spara och Betala – med särskilt fokus på bolån.
   

  

 Vår verksamhet är fördelad mellan Stockholm och Linköping. I Stockholm finns majoriteten av vår verksamhet, medan vår kundservice har sitt hjärta i Linköping. Tillsammans är vi cirka 270 medarbetare anställda på banken som varje dag skapar smarta lösningar för våra kunder.
   

  

**Vårt Erbjudande Inkluderar**
* Låna: Transparenta och attraktivt prissatta bolån
* Spara: Sparande i fonder och aktier samt på sparkonto
* Betala: Lönekonto samt smidiga kort- och betalningstjänster.


 Vi tror på att människor som utvecklas, presterar och mår bra är nyckeln till framgång. Hos oss är kompetensutveckling och lärande självklara delar av vardagen – framåt tillsammans!

title: Product Designer
description:
**About Air Apps**
 At Air Apps, we believe in thinking bigger—and moving faster. We’re a family-founded company on a mission to create the world’s first AI-powered Personal & Entrepreneurial Resource Planner (PRP), and we need your passion and ambition to help us change how people plan, work, and live. Born in Lisbon, Portugal in 2018—and now with offices in both Lisbon and San Francisco - we’ve remained self-funded while reaching over 100 million downloads worldwide.
   

  

 Our long-term focus drives us to challenge the status quo every day, pushing the boundaries of AI-driven solutions that truly make a difference. Here, you’ll be a creative force, shaping products that empower people across the globe.
   

  

 Join us on this journey to redefine resource management—and change lives along the way.
   

  

****The Role****
 As a
 **Product Designer** 
 , you will be responsible for crafting intuitive, delightful user experiences that seamlessly span mobile (iOS and Android) and web platforms. You will work closely with cross-functional teams—including Product Management, Engineering, and User Research—to translate complex requirements into elegant, user-centered designs. You will leverage your design sensibilities, storytelling abilities, and understanding of technology constraints to build consistent, scalable solutions that resonate with a wide range of users.
   

  

* This is a fully onsite position, based at our office in Lisbon, where you will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams in person and contribute to a dynamic and fast-paced environment. We are open to support with relocation efforts.


**Responsibilities**
* Conduct user research, interviews, and usability testing to deeply understand user needs, pain points, and behaviors. Translate insights into wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity mockups.
* Develop and maintain design systems and component libraries that ensure a cohesive look and feel across iOS, Android, and web interfaces while respecting platform-specific patterns and guidelines.
* Own the entire design process - from concept ideation and user flows to final visual design - ensuring a pixel-perfect, responsive experience across devices and screen sizes.
* Work closely with Product Managers to shape product strategy and define requirements, and partner with Engineers to ensure technical feasibility and a smooth handoff of assets and specifications.
* Continuously refine designs based on user feedback, A/B testing results, and analytics. Strive for iterative improvements that drive measurable increases in user satisfaction, engagement, and retention.
* Advocate for user experience best practices and contribute to the ongoing improvement of design processes, tooling, and team culture.
* Provide mentorship and guidance to less experienced designers, fostering a collaborative and inclusive design environment.


**Requirements**
* Bachelor’s degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), or related field.
* Approximately 3+ years of experience in modern design and prototyping tools (e.g., Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD).
* Solid understanding of layout, typography, and color theory, with an eye for detail and usability.
* Familiarity with native mobile design patterns (Human Interface Guidelines for iOS, Material Design for Android) as well as responsive web design principles.
* Experience conducting user research, usability testing, and applying both qualitative and quantitative feedback to improve designs.


**What benefits are we offering?**
* Apple hardware ecosystem for work.
* Annual Bonus
* Top-tier Health and Life Insurance for peace of mind.
* Transportation Budget to support your commute needs.
* Coverflex benefits package for meal allowances, well-being, and more.
* Childcare support.
* Air Conference - an opportunity to meet the team, collaborate, and grow together.
* Pension Fund to support your long-term financial planning.
* Urban Sports Club membership to keep you active.
* Meals 100% free at the hub.


****Diversity & Inclusion****
 At Air Apps, we are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace. We enthusiastically welcome applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We celebrate diversity in all its forms and believe that varied voices and experiences make us stronger.
   

  

****Application Disclaimer****
 At Air Apps, we value transparency and integrity in our hiring process. Applicants must submit their own work without any AI-generated assistance. Any use of AI in application materials, assessments, or interviews will result in disqualification.
   

  

 Compensation Range: €36K - €46K

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
We’re looking for a Senior product designer to help shape the next layer of SeenThis: a product where creative and marketing teams can build, run, measure, and improve high-performing video campaigns across channels.
   

  

 This is a role for an AI-native designer who likes complex problems, expert users, and fast execution. You’ll work close to product and engineering, own meaningful parts of our media and advertising product suite, and help turn complicated workflows into tools people want to use every day.
   

  

**About SeenThis**
 The open web has massive untapped advertising potential, but video has historically underperformed here. SeenThis is changing that. As a video advertising partner, we prove the open web delivers exceptional results, capturing more attention with cost-effective video that keeps publishers profitable and the internet independent. Since 2017, we've served billions of streams for 5,000+ brands across 50+ countries. We believe brands deserve reach wherever audiences are, publishers deserve sustainable revenue, and the internet deserves to stay open.
   

  

 Our team of 130+ employees works globally from offices in Stockholm, Oslo, London, Paris, Singapore, Hong Kong, New York, and Sydney. We're expanding across all teams and constantly seeking new colleagues who want to make real impact in a fast-moving, collaborative environment where innovation happens daily.
   

  

 Do you want to be part of our journey, where we dare to discover, own it, and win together?
   

  

 Join SeenThis!
   

  

**About The Role**
 Our adaptive streaming technology fixed the delivery problem for video advertising. Now we’re building the product layer on top.
   

  

 You’ll own parts of our media and advertising product suite, working closely with engineers, a PM, and the Design Lead to take ideas from first sketch to shipped product. You’ll help define how our product works, how it feels, and how product design works at SeenThis as the function continues to grow.
   

  

 While you will iterate and build fast, your role starts with discovery. You’ll be expected to become a domain expert for your part of our products. That means continually talking with customers, mapping their workflows, understanding the business context, and finding real problems.
   

  

 You’ll be expected to figure out what’s worth building before any screen is designed. Sometimes that means proper research or session data. Other times, a client call and a rough prototype may be the answer. That’s up to you.
   

  

 Getting this right is most of the job, because the wrong thing built well is still the wrong thing.
   

  

 This is also an execution-first and AI-native role. You’ll move quickly from problem to prototype to shipped product, using tools like Claude Code to explore ideas, test flows, and iterate faster.
   

  

 Building is cheap now; judgment is the scarce part. When AI can produce the screen, the work that matters is deciding what to build, what to cut, where to simplify, and when to push back. That part is still yours.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Run discovery for your product area: talk to customers, dig into the problem, map workflows, and decide what’s worth building before committing to a build.
* Become a domain expert for your part of the product, with a strong understanding of users, workflows, constraints, and business goals.
* Choose the right tool for each question: proper research when it warrants it, session data or support insights when that’s enough, and a fast prototype when that answers it sooner.
* Own user flows, interactions, and interfaces from first discovery through to shipped product.
* Design for expert users doing complex work, making powerful workflows feel clear, fast, and simple enough to use every day.
* Talk to users directly through client calls, support tickets, and session data, and form product opinions from what you find.
* Work hands-on with engineers through the build, not just at handoff.
* Use AI tools, including Claude Code, to design, prototype, and iterate. Build your own small tools when that’s faster.
* Contribute to product strategy and roadmap with your PM and the rest of the team.
* Help shape our design system and how design works at SeenThis while both are still taking shape.


**Qualifications**
* Have 5+ years of product design experience, with the seniority to own complex work from discovery through shipped product.
* Start with the problem, not the screen, and have shipped work where discovery shaped the outcome.
* Have designed complex digital products end to end, with work you can walk through and explain.
* Have a portfolio that shows clear thinking, polished UI, and real outcomes rather than well-composed screens.
* Move fluidly between early discovery, rough prototypes, high-fidelity execution, and hands-on iteration with engineers.
* Treat prototyping as a way to think, test, and align, not just a deliverable to produce.
* Already work AI-native, with real opinions about where Claude Code or similar tools help and where they get in the way.
* Are a designer who builds, not one who hands off.
* Are solid across UX, interaction, IA, and visual design, with the technical curiosity to understand how the product behaves, not only how it looks.
* Bring high ownership and low ego, and can drive your own work forward while the team and product are still forming.


**Application**
 As we review applications and interview on a continuous basis, please apply as soon as possible. Due to the high volume of applications received, we are unable to provide personalized feedback prior to the interview stage. Thank you for understanding!
   

  

**Please note:** 
 we're in our summer holiday period. Response times may be a little longer than usual, and we will get back to all candidates with feedback once the holiday period is over. Thank you for your understanding and patience!
   

  

 We conduct background checks on all SeenThis-hires to comply with our customers and protect business-critical information.
   

  

 We look forward to welcoming you to SeenThis!
   

  

 Status Quo-what? With courage and curiosity, we explore the unknown in the quest for game-changing-impact.
   

  

 To us, ownership is more than just another buzzword. It's our driving force. We own our projects and nurture them from idea to reality.
   

  

 To us, it's essential to forge deep connections both within SeenThis and with our clients. And, we approach every challenge and celebrate each success as a unified team
   

  

 The open web represents the internet's greatest untapped advertising opportunity. While 61% of consumer time happens here, across premium publishers, diverse voices, and independent content, only 29% of ad budgets follow. SeenThis is changing that.
   

  

 Our proprietary adaptive streaming technology proves the open web can outperform walled gardens, delivering 70% more attention and exceptional campaign results for brands while keeping publishers profitable and the internet independent.
   

  

 Since 2017, we've served over 40 billion impressions for 5,000+ brands across 50+ countries, partnering with agencies and publishers from eight offices worldwide.
   

  

 Brands deserve reach wherever their audiences are, publishers deserve sustainable revenue, and the internet deserves to stay open and thriving. SeenThis unlocks the open web's full potential. For more information, visit www.seenthis.co

title: Design System Manager
description:
**Who We Are**
 Worldline helps businesses of all shapes and sizes to accelerate their growth journey - quickly, simply, and securely. We are the innovators at the heart of the payments technology industry, shaping how the world pays and gets paid. Our technology powers the growth of millions of businesses across 5 continents. And just as we help our customers accelerate their business, we are committed to helping our people accelerate their careers. Together, we shape the evolution.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 Design at Worldline is going through an exciting transformation. We're raising the bar — fast. At the centre of that transformation is our Design System: a world-class foundation we're building with talented people who care deeply about craft, consistency, and scale. It's already creating significant impact across our product portfolio, and we're just getting started. The ambition is high, the team is strong and growing more diverse every day, and there's a real sense that we're shaking things up.
   

  

 As our Design System Manager, you will own the strategy, governance, and evolution of the Worldline Design System — the shared foundation that enables our product teams to deliver consistent, high-quality experiences at scale. Coming from a design background, you understand the craft and the "why" behind every component; with a strong affinity for frontend development, you can bridge the gap between design decisions and technical implementation. Your mission is to make the Design System a product in its own right — one that serves designers and developers alike, accelerates delivery, and raises the quality bar across our entire product portfolio. You will lead cross-functional collaboration, align stakeholders, and build the processes that keep the system healthy and evolving.
   

  

 This role is based in Stockholm, Sweden.
   

  

**Day-to-day Responsibilities**
* Own the vision, roadmap, and governance of the Worldline Design System, treating it as a product with clear goals, priorities, and success metrics.
* Lead the end-to-end lifecycle of design system components — from identifying needs and defining patterns, through design and documentation, to handoff and adoption tracking.
* Bridge the gap between design and frontend engineering, ensuring components are both designerly and technically sound — working closely with developers who implement the system in code.
* Establish and maintain contribution guidelines, quality standards, and governance processes so the system scales sustainably.
* Collaborate closely with product designers across teams to understand their needs, gather feedback, and ensure the system evolves to support real product challenges.
* Champion design tokens, accessibility standards, and responsive patterns to ensure consistency across platforms and products.
* Nurture adoption of the Design System across product teams, providing training, documentation, and hands-on support to designers and developers.
* Stay ahead of design system trends, tooling innovations, and frontend technologies to continuously improve how we build and maintain our system.
* Actively explore opportunities for our business and the field of design systems with generative and Agentic AI — from automated documentation to intelligent component suggestions.
* Advocate for the Design System as a strategic asset within the organisation, communicating its value to senior stakeholders and product leadership.
* Become a key member of the Worldline Design team, shaping our design infrastructure and contributing to our culture of consistency, craft, and mutual support.


**Who Are We Looking For**
 We look for talented, thoughtful people who care about their craft and the people they serve. People who bring fresh perspectives, step up and show what's next — optimistic, upbeat people with a can-do attitude, a hunger to learn and grow, and a genuine love for collaboration. In practice this means:
   

  

* 5+ years of experience in product design or design systems, with at least 2 years of hands-on experience building, maintaining, or managing a design system.
* A design background with a strong understanding of UI design principles, component architecture, design patterns, and visual consistency.
* Frontend affinity — you may not write production code daily, but you understand HTML/CSS, component frameworks (e.g., React), design tokens, and how design translates to implementation. Hands-on frontend experience is a strong plus.
* Proven experience managing a design system as a product — including roadmapping, prioritisation, stakeholder management, and adoption measurement.
* Expert-level Figma skills, including component architecture, variants, variables, auto-layout, and library management.
* Strong understanding of accessibility standards (WCAG) and how they apply to design system components.
* Experience creating and maintaining design system documentation that serves both designers and developers.
* Excellent verbal and written English communication skills, with the ability to align diverse stakeholders — from designers and developers to product managers and leadership.
* A collaborative and service-oriented mindset — you see the design system as an enabler for others and find satisfaction in making your colleagues more effective.
* A systems-thinking mindset with a keen eye for detail and a passion for order, scalability, and maintainability.
* An optimistic, warm personality — you bring positive energy to your collaborations, value diverse perspectives, and believe great systems are built by great teams supporting each other.
* Industry experience in payments or B2B SaaS is a nice-to-have — what matters most is your design system expertise and design craft. Domain knowledge you'll learn on the job.
* You have an online portfolio or case study showcasing your design system work, which you can share upon application.
* You are available to work full time.


**Perks & Benefits**
 At Worldline you'll get the chance to be at the heart of the global payments technology industry and shape how the world pays and gets paid. On top of that, you will also:
   

  

* Work with inspiring colleagues in a supportive, inclusive environment and be empowered to learn, grow and accelerate your career.
* Health contribution
* Health check – Every 2:nd year
* Private Health Care Insurance (EuroAccident)
* Parental pay and 12 months pension during parental leave
* Opportunity to hybrid working according to company standard
* Benefit portal with many great offers, plus more.


**Shape the evolution**
 We are on an exciting journey towards the next frontiers of payments technology, and we look for big thinkers, people with passion, can-do attitude and a hunger to learn and grow. Here you'll work with ambitious colleagues from around the world, take on unique challenges as a team, and make a real impact on the society. With an empowering culture, strong technology and extensive training opportunities, we help you accelerate your career - wherever you decide to go. Join our global team of 18,000 innovators and shape a tomorrow that is yours to own.
   

  

 Learn more about life at Worldline at jobs.worldline.com
   

  

 We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as an individual with a disability, or any applicable legally protected characteristics.

title: Product Owner
description:
**HAYPP GROUP**
 We address one of the world’s biggest problems – how to end smoking. There are 1,1 billion smokers in the world. Around 8 million people die every year from smoking-related diseases. Our goal is to significantly reduce death rates, save lives and inspire people to choose smoke-free enjoyment. How? By offering people other nicotine products online.
   

  

 Haypp Group is one of the Nordics’ leading e-commerce groups with eleven store brands, present in seven countries where we serve more than 1 million active consumers. Through brands such as Snusbolaget.se, Northerner.com, Nicokick.com etc., we sell nicotine pouches, Swedish style snus online as well as disposable vapes. With our headquarters located on Östgötagatan in Stockholm we are 300 team members mainly but not exclusively based in Sweden. Also, we are an innovative and fast-moving company that is growing rapidly, driving sustainable business and are changing the world in the process. We are currently on an exciting expansion journey, converting more and more smokers to smoke-free alternatives across all our markets globally.
   

  

**THE ROLE**
 We’re looking for a
 **Product Owner** 
 to join our US Product team and take a central role in shaping, developing, and optimizing our e-commerce experience. The role is based in our Stockholm office, where you will work closely with colleagues across Product, Technology, Marketing, and Commercial teams, while supporting the continued growth of our US business.
   

  

 Haypp Group is entering an exciting growth phase, with the U.S. market expanding rapidly. This role is a great opportunity for someone who wants to be close to one of our most important growth journeys and help shape the e-commerce experience that will support it.
   

  

 As Product Owner, you will be involved in the product vision, roadmap, and delivery for key parts of our online customer journey. You will help build scalable, high-performing solutions that support both our current business and our future growth ambitions, ensuring that our platforms drive both short-term commercial performance and long-term sustainable growth.
   

  

 You will work closely with stakeholders across e-commerce, marketing, commercial, product, design, analytics, and technology teams. You will also collaborate closely with the Global Marketing and Product teams, as well as the US market team, acting as a bridge between global product strategy and local market execution.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Help define priorities and manage the product backlog for key parts of the US e-commerce experience
* Collaborate closely with engineering, design, analytics, commercial, and marketing teams to deliver impactful product improvements
* Drive the optimization of the online customer journey, with a focus on conversion, retention, and customer experience
* Translate business needs into clear product requirements, user stories, and prioritized development plans
* Ensure alignment between global product strategy and local US market needs
* Monitor product performance through KPIs and customer insights, continuously identifying opportunities for improvement
* Facilitate agile product development processes and manage backlog prioritization together with development teams
* Act as the primary stakeholder for your product area, ensuring strong communication and alignment across teams


**What We Are Looking For**
* Strong understanding of e-commerce platforms, customer journeys, conversion optimization, and digital growth
* Experience working with cross-functional teams including engineering, design, analytics, marketing, and commercial stakeholders
* Ability to translate business needs into clear product requirements and prioritized roadmaps
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to align different teams around shared priorities
* Experience working with agile development teams and managing product backlogs
* Data-driven mindset with the ability to make informed product decisions based on customer and business insights

title: PRODUCT OWNER
description:
**Product Owner**
 Loyalty Solutions at SAS Digital & IT is looking for a Product Owner.
   

  

**As Product Owner Your Main Responsibilities Will Be To**
* Translate business needs and requirements into clear, actionable user stories and technical specifications.
* Work in close partnership with the Business Product Manager(s) to align product vision, roadmap, and priorities across the assigned product portfolio.
* Own the digital scope of the product, ensuring alignment with UX, UI, security, accessibility, and platform standards.
* Collaborate closely with the Scrum Master on sprint ceremonies and team ways of working, contributing to planning, retrospectives, and continuous improvement.
* Collaborate closely with designers, engineers, QA, and DevOps to ensure consistent, timely, and high-quality deliveries.
* Continuously monitor customer feedback, analytics, and technical performance to drive iterative product improvements.
* Coordinate the resolution of technical debt and ensure long-term maintainability of digital solutions.
* Prioritize and manage the digital product backlog in sync with the Business Product Manager(s) and other IT Product Owners having requests, clearly communicating goals and requirements to delivery teams.
* Ensure that all digital touchpoints comply with accessibility standards, data protection policies, and cybersecurity requirements.
* Support the team in removing blockers and enabling efficient collaboration and delivery.
* Serve as the central point of contact for digital product performance and improvement planning.
* Engage stakeholders across Digital & IT and relevant business units to align on delivery timelines, requirements, and dependencies.


**The Team**
 You will be part of Loyalty Solutions within SAS Digital & IT and will be assigned part of our product portfolio.
   

  

 The team develops and maintains most of the core profile, customer authentication, and identity platforms, and builds products and services available to our customers and EuroBonus members, including profile services, online member pages, partner integrations (credit cards, car rental, hotels, and more), and SkyTeam Alliance loyalty integrations. The team also provides backend services to internal IT teams, enabling their product roadmaps together with their commercial stakeholders. The team also drives loyalty fraud prevention and account security.
   

  

**To be successful we believe you have**
* Strong ability to translate business needs into actionable technical tasks and user stories.
* Proven experience managing digital product roadmaps and backlogs.
* Solid understanding of agile and SAFe-like delivery environments, working with cross-functional teams (developers, designers, QA).
* Familiarity with modern UX/UI practices, digital accessibility, data privacy, and secure development principles.
* Experience with agile tooling such as Jira and Confluence.
* Excellent understanding of customer experience, digital standards, and performance monitoring.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.


**Education & Experience**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Digital Product Development, or equivalent practical experience.
* Minimum 3–5 years of experience in digital product ownership, product management, or technical project management.
* Experience in agile, SAFe-like delivery environments, especially working with cross-functional teams.
* Familiarity with modern UX/UI practices, digital accessibility, data privacy, and secure development principles.
* A background in the airline, travel, or e-commerce industries is an advantage. Experience specifically within customer authentication & security, loyalty programs, fraud prevention or similar domains is particularly valued.


**We Believe You Are**
* Eager to put your creativity and sense of innovation to work to further develop SAS.
* Someone who enjoys being part of a high-performing, multi-skilled, customer-centric team.
* A strong team player who keeps SAS’s overall interest in mind and avoids sub-optimizing.
* Organized and proactive, with a structured approach to managing competing priorities.
* Curious, collaborative, and committed to continuous improvement.
* Able to balance technical considerations with user value and business impact.
* An excellent communicator, both written and verbal, comfortable with business stakeholders and IT providers alike.
* Open-minded and embracing of cultural differences.
* Able to analyze problems and come up with working solutions.


**Other**
* Travel to development teams at offshore partner expected 1–2 times per year.
* Reporting to the Head of Loyalty Solutions in business unit Commercial Solutions, Digital & IT.


**Why SAS?**
**Benefits**
 At SAS, we offer extensive opportunities for professional development in an international, fast-paced working environment. We are dedicated to the continuous growth of our employees. Working with us comes with a variety of benefits, including:
   

  

* Travel Perks: Enjoy discounted travel opportunities around the world with SAS.
* Health & Wellness: Access to health and wellness benefits, including a newly renovated gym with complimentary classes such as CrossFit and yoga.
* Discounts: Receive discounts from a wide range of brands, as well as on transportation to and from airports, airport shops, hotels, and car rentals.
* Work Environment: Our office location in Frösundavik offers a vibrant workspace with a restaurant, café, and easy access to outdoor activities in Hagaparken and Brunnsviken. Engage in running, tennis, outdoor gym sessions, kayaking, and stand-up paddling with equipment available free of charge.
* Convenient Commute: Benefit from a non-stop bus service connecting our office to Solna station and commuter trains, alongside a network of cycle paths.


**Our Culture at SAS**
 At SAS, we are dedicated to caring for each other, delighting our travelers, and driving the transformation towards sustainable aviation. As a future colleague on our team, you’ll join a culture where we work collaboratively towards common goals, recognize each other’s contributions, and celebrate successes. Our focus is on safe, sustainable, and punctual execution, and we are committed to protecting our planet while transforming SAS for the future. This is an empowering workplace where you can thrive, grow, and take ownership of your work. Join us at SAS and be part of shaping the future of aviation!
   

  

 Come and fly with us!
   

  

**Additional Information**
* Las day to send in your application is 16/8-2026. Please send us your CV as soon as possible as interviews are conducted continuously and the position may be filled before the application deadline. Note that we are not able to handle applications sent by email, due to GDPR regulations.
* Position: Full-time (100%) starting with a 6-month probation period.
* This position is based in Frösundavik, Solna (Stockholm). You will be expected to work onsite. Remote work may also be an option, depending on the agreement made with your manager.
* A background check will be conducted at the first stage of this recruitment process, as this role is security classified. We kindly ask you to be transparent about any relevant matters during the recruitment process.
* Please note that we do not sponsor work visas for this position. Applicants must be eligible to live and work in Sweden.

title: Framer Website Designer
description:
****Framer Website Designer (Onsite – Presidio, San Francisco)****
**About Air Apps**
 At Air Apps, we believe in thinking bigger and moving faster. We’re a family-founded company on a mission to create the world’s first AI-powered Personal & Entrepreneurial Resource Planner (PRP), and we need your passion and ambition to help us change how people plan, work, and live. Born in Lisbon, Portugal in 2018 and now with offices in both Lisbon and San Francisco, we’ve remained self-funded while reaching over 100 million downloads worldwide.
   

  

 Our long-term focus drives us to challenge the status quo every day, pushing the boundaries of AI-driven solutions that truly make a difference. Here, you’ll be a creative force, shaping products that empower people across the globe.
   

  

 Join us on this journey to redefine resource management and change lives along the way.
   

  

* This is a fully onsite position, based at our office in Lisbon, where you will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams in person and contribute to a dynamic and fast-paced environment. We are open to support with relocation efforts.


**The Role**
 As a
 **Framer Website Designer**

 **Framer**

 You’ll also work directly with

****Application Disclaimer****

title: Motion Designer
description:
Kom och sätt ett av Sveriges starkaste varumärken i rörelse
   

  

 Vi bygger en Content Studio för ett av Sveriges mest kända varumärken — högt tempo, hög kreativ ambition och kort väg från idé till publicerat. Vi söker dig som tänker i rörelse. Som instinktivt vet hur ett klipp ska kännas innan det är klippt, hur en animation ska andas innan den renderas och hur timing i motion är lika mycket känsla som teknik. Inte motion för rörlighetens skull, utan rörligt innehåll som faktiskt fångar uppmärksamhet, driver engagemang och känns helt samtida i flödet. Och det du skapar når miljontals människor varje dag.
   

  

 Hos oss på Swedbank har du en möjlighet att:
   

  

* Jobba med ett av Sveriges mest kända varumärken — och sätta det i rörelse i digitala kanaler varje dag.
* Nå miljontals människor genom Sveriges mest besökta digitala plattformar och kanaler — räckvidd på en skala få motion designers någonsin får uppleva.
* Sätta standarden för hur ett av Sveriges starkaste varumärken ser ut i rörelse — du kommer inte in för att förvalta ett gammalt arv, utan för att bygga något nytt från grunden.
* Skapa rörligt innehåll från idé till färdig leverans — motion design, animation och digital storytelling för sociala och digitala flöden.
* Omsätta budskap och riktning till animerade format som känns genomarbetade och samtida.
* Arbeta med templates och skalbar motionproduktion utan att tappa kreativ känsla.
* Jobba nära content creator, copywriters, designers och marknadsteam i en miljö där bra idéer snabbt ska bli verklighet.


 I denna roll behöver du:
   

  

* Vara visuellt exceptionell med ett uttryck som lutar åt creator snarare än corporate. Det här är ingen "duktig på After Effects"-rekrytering — jag letar efter en naturlig känsla för rörelse, rytm, tempo och storytelling, och du vet i magen när ett klipp sitter.
* 2–5 års erfarenhet av motion design från reklambyrå, inhousebyrå eller kreativ miljö — men är du relativt tidig i karriären med rätt fingertoppskänsla för vad som fångar organisk uppmärksamhet idag är det inget hinder.
* Mycket starka kunskaper i After Effects och Premiere Pro — du arbetar snabbt, obehindrat och utan att leta i menyer. Verktygen är en självklarhet, inte poängen.
* En portfolio som visar skillnaden mellan animation som "bara" ser snygg ut och animation som faktiskt gör något — du vet vad du gör och varför.
* Stark känsla för tempo, rytm och bildkomposition, och koll på visuella trender — du brinner för digital kommunikation som andas nutid.
* Snabb utan att bli slarvig — du växlar sömlöst mellan genomarbetad, tyngre motionproduktion och snabbare, skalbar contentproduktion utan att någonsin tappa känslan för hantverket.
* Du förstår att vi är en bank, men använder det som en kreativ parameter, inte en ursäkt för att göra trygga och genomsnittliga grejer. Compliant utan att vara försiktig — du testar ramarna för vad som är möjligt men vet precis var de går.
* Genuint nyfiken på AI och använder det redan aktivt i ditt arbete – du testar, utforskar och hittar sätt att jobba smartare och mer kreativt med de verktyg som finns.
* Erfarenhet av att arbeta med exempelvis Gettyfilmer och integrera materialet i olika format.
* Självgående och prestigelös — du ser vad som behöver göras och driver arbetet framåt utan att vänta på att få ett problem serverat. Du delar generöst med dig av idéer, tar feedback med ro och lämnar egot utanför dörren. Det är inget önskemål, det är ett krav.
* Svenska och engelska — du arbetar, tänker och kommunicerar lika bra på båda.


 Hos oss kan du uppleva:
   

  

* Personlig och professionell utveckling genom självledarskap och kontinuerlig utveckling.
* Meningsfullt arbete som positivt påverkar vår arbetsplats, våra kunder och samhället.
* En öppen och samarbetsinriktad kultur som uppmuntrar tvärfunktionellt teamarbete och erbjuder nätverksmöjligheter.
* En stöttande och inkluderande miljö som främjar en balanserad och hållbar arbetslivssituation, med flexibla arbetsförhållanden när det passar rollen.
* Förmåner såsom vårt erbjudande för bankprodukter för anställda, tjänstepensionsplan, aktiebaserade belöningsprogram Eken, och friskvårdsbidraget.


 "Bli en del av vårt team och...
   

  

 …bygga något som aldrig funnits på Swedbank tidigare. Rätt person i den här rollen lyfter inte bara sitt eget arbete utan höjer hela rummet och sätter nivån för hela studion. Vi har varumärket, räckvidden och ambitionerna – nu letar jag efter dig som ska sätta oss i rörelse. Är det dig jag letar efter? Då vill jag att vi pratar. Jag ser fram emot att bygga det här tillsammans med dig."
 **Magnus Fingal, din framtida chef**
 Vi ser fram emot din ansökan senast den 2026-08-16.
   

  

**Placeringsort: Stockholm, Sundbyberg**
**Rekryterande chef: Magnus Fingal**
**I den här rekryteringen samarbetar Swedbank med Bohmans Nätverk, som även ansvarar för urvalsprocessen. För frågor om rollen, kontakta Anders Welin på 0706 33 21 37 eller** 
**anders.welin@bohmans.com** 
**, alternativt Linda Schmidt på 076 408 77 91 eller** 
**linda.schmidt@bohmans.com** 
**. Vi ser gärna att du skickar in din ansökan direkt till någon av ovanstående kontaktpersoner.**
 Vänligen observera att rekryteringsarbetet kan ta lite längre tid än normalt då det är sommarsemester.
   

  

 Vi vill göra dig uppmärksam på att bakgrundskontroll och drogtest kan komma att genomföras för denna roll om du går vidare i processen.
   

  

*Vi har gjort vårt medieval för rekrytering och undanber oss därför kontakt med annonssäljare eller säljare av andra rekryteringstjänster.*
**Swedbank är en inkluderande arbetsgivare och diskriminerar ingen utifrån kön, ålder, sexuell läggning eller sexuell identitet, etnicitet, religion eller funktionsnedsättning - alla är välkomna.**

title: Junior Fashion Designer - H&M Light Woven
description:
**Job Description**

 An exciting opportunity awaits at H&M! We’re looking for a passionate Junior Fashion Designer to join our Womenswear Light Woven team and help bring inspiring, fashion-forward collections to life for millions of customers around the world.
   

  





 As a Junior Designer, you’ll play an essential role in shaping trend-driven collections that truly connect with our customer. If you thrive in a fast-paced, creative environment and have a keen eye for detail, this is your chance to make an impact. From identifying emerging trends and developing fresh concepts to supporting the design process through to the final product, you’ll bring creativity, innovation, and energy to every stage. Working alongside a talented team, you’ll help transform ideas into exciting collections that inspire customers every season.
   

  





**WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH**




 You’ll collaborate closely with our Product Designers and cross-functional partners, including Product Managers, Pattern Makers, Print Designers, Buyers, Planners, Product Developers, and Business Controllers.
   

  





**Your day-to-day will include:**



* Creating and updating flat sketches and collection overviews
* Supporting Product Team
* Working with technical packs
* Contributing to collections sold across all global H&M markets



 You’ll be part of an ambitious, innovative, and energetic team that thrives on collaboration, creativity, and forward thinking.

 You’re curious, adaptable, and inspired by fashion. You love working at pace and aren’t afraid to share your perspective. You bring both creativity and structure—and you’re eager to grow.

 H&M Group is a global family of fashion brands and ventures driven by one purpose: to prove that great design, affordability, and sustainability can go hand in hand.

 Our strength lies in our people—our creativity, our values, and our shared belief in growth and collaboration.
   

  





 Take the next step in your fashion career with H&M.
   

  

 The journey truly starts here.
   

  





 To apply, please submit your CV and portfolio (PDF, max 10MB) in English.
   

  





 The journey starts here.

title: Customer Success Manager - Higher Education
description:
Mentimeter is an engagement tool with a clear goal in mind. To turn presentations into conversations. Through real-time interactivity and clear visualizations, we get people to participate, engage and become more productive. Transforming all those passive meetings, airless classrooms and drawn out trainings into valuable and memorable moments.
   

  

 We truly believe that you achieve the best results by doing things together. And that successful leaders need to adopt a curious and collaborative mindset in order to get there. So with you at Mentimeter, you’ll be a big part of the ambition to help over 1 billion people listen, learn and work better together.
   

  

 We are looking for someone with high energy, an entrepreneurial tempo with the main focus on commercial initiatives to drive retention and revenue growth among our Higher education Enterprise customers. Our next team member understands how to create long-term strategic relationships with customers
 **.**
 We’re now looking for a
 **Customer Success Manager** 
 to join our growing Higher ed team, focusing specifically on our Higher Education customers across universities and academic institutions in EMEA.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Customer Success Manager – Higher Education, your mission is to ensure our customers gain maximum value from their investment in Mentimeter. You’ll drive product adoption, engagement, and long-term success by understanding the unique needs of educational environments and aligning them with our Enterprise solutions.
   

  

 You’ll collaborate closely with Relationship Managers to deliver a seamless customer experience, guiding institutions through onboarding, training, and value realization. With an understanding of the academic world’s rhythm, you’ll play a key role in adapting our success strategies to align with semester-based cycles, pedagogical goals, and diverse stakeholder groups.
   

  

 To deliver this outstanding experience, you’ll work cross-functionally with colleagues in Product, Marketing, and Sales. You’ll serve as a strategic partner on assigned accounts, bridging the gap between customer needs and Mentimeter’s solutions.
   

  

**What Makes This Role Unique**
* Be part of a team that’s shaping the future of learning in universities around the world
* Help educators create more inclusive and student-centered teaching environments
* Join a fast-growing company where your impact and insights directly influence our approach in a key vertical


**Who You Are**
 We’re looking for an experienced Customer Success Manager who is passionate about driving customer value and long-term relationships. You bring a structured, proactive, and collaborative approach, with the ability to work across multiple stakeholders and functions.
   

  

 While experience in the higher education sector is a plus, it’s absolutely not required. What matters most is your experience in a CSM role, along with your curiosity, adaptability, and eagerness to understand the unique challenges and opportunities of this space. If you're excited about helping educators and institutions succeed with innovative solutions—and want to be part of a team that drives growth—you’ll thrive in this role.
   

  

 At Mentimeter, we believe in the power of potential. If you bring the right mindset and ambition, this is a place where you can grow quickly and make a meaningful difference.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Manage a portfolio of Enterprise customers across the higher education vertical
* Help your Enterprise customers develop successful onboarding, roll-out and training strategies by working closely with C-level stakeholders and key influencers in various departments/teams/regions.
* Partner with stakeholders to ensure they achieve maximum value from Mentimeter
* Collaborate with Relationship Managers to grow and retain accounts
* Deliver webinars, workshops, and data-driven insights to boost usage
* Be the customer’s voice internally—inform product, sales, and business development
* Monitor customer health and act proactively to drive better outcomes
* Contribute to a scalable, world-class Customer Success strategy


**What’s Not In Scope**
* Closing new deals (done by Account Executives)
* Commercial ownership of existing customers (handled by Relationship Managers)
* Daily support tickets (covered by our Support Specialist)


**Support You'll Have**
* Strong lead generation from Marketing & Product
* Dedicated Sales, Ops, and Enablement teams
* Tools like PlanHat, Salesforce, Mixpanel, Intercom & more


**Compensation At Mentimeter**
 At Mentimeter, we believe in fair and transparent compensation that grows with you.
   

  

 The salary range for this role is SEK 50–60,000 per month. It’s intentionally broad to reflect the different stages of growth within the role: from early development to deep expertise and meaningful impact.
   

  

 Where an individual is placed within the range depends on factors such as relevant experience, demonstrated skills, and alignment with the role’s requirements.
   

  

 We’re committed to supporting your growth. You’ll have ongoing development conversations with your manager, and your salary will evolve as you build skills and contribute to our mission.
   

  

 In addition to your monthly salary, we offer a comprehensive benefits package—learn more about it here: https://www.mentimeter.com/benefits/stockholm
   

  

**What Mentimeter Can Offer**
 At Mentimeter we can offer a diverse and inclusive work environment supported by smart and driven colleagues. We believe in continuous professional development for all of our colleagues and therefore offer access to a leadership program (including external personal coach) and relevant education to ensure that we continue to be state-of-the-art when it comes to innovating and building Mentimeter. Your place will be in a growing company with lots of career opportunities, working on a beloved product used by more than 300 million people. It’s not all about work though, we also offer a very healthy view on work-life balance.
   

  

 All of this comes attached with a competitive compensation and benefits package, including pension contributions. Learn more about our benefits by visiting our Benefits & Perks page
   

  

**AI and Hiring at Mentimeter**
 At Mentimeter, we believe AI helps us work smarter - but it never replaces the human assessment, curiosity, and personal connection that define our culture and our hiring. We use AI as a sparring partner: to bounce ideas, bring new perspectives, support structure, and make our work more efficient. But the meaning, decisions, and interactions always come from people.
   

  

* AI does not screen or decide on candidates.
* There is no automated filtering, ranking, or decision-making in our recruitment process. Every application is reviewed by a person.
* Hiring teams may use AI to support their work - for example, to structure notes, prepare interview questions, or organize their thinking.


 AI strengthens our work, but it does not define it. At Mentimeter, we’re not building an AI-driven hiring process - we’re building a people-first culture, where technology helps us listen, learn, and grow together.
   

  

**Culture at Mentimeter**
 At Mentimeter we believe in giving everyone a voice - regardless of who you are. So we build a platform that does just that. Our platform is not only our product but also our organization. A platform where people feel safe, where differences are embraced, a place where you can have fun. We strongly encourage applicants who are people of color, LGBTQ+, women, people with disabilities, and/or formerly incarcerated people, and a college degree is not strictly required. In order to give everyone a voice, we need to be as diverse as our users.
   

  

 Learn more about our culture by visiting our Culture page.
   

  

 Review our Privacy Policy for more information.

 Det här är en roll för dig som trivs med att äga och driva ditt område. Som ensam inredare hos oss blir du en nyckelperson i arbetet med våra koncepthotell och du arbetar nära våra hotell, leverantörer och samarbetspartners.
   

  

 Eftersom vi arbetar med väletablerade hotellkoncept ligger fokus i rollen på att implementera, vidareutveckla och kvalitetssäkra våra befintliga design- och inredningskoncept på samtliga hotell.
   

  

**Dina Främsta Arbetsuppgifter Är Kommer Att Vara**
* Att jobba med inredning/styling samt ska hålla dig uppdaterad med nya trender och erbjudanden inom möbler, belysning och design
* Support till alla våra koncepthotell när det gäller design, inredning, styling, grafik etc.
* Implementera etablerade inredningskoncept och grafisk kommunikation
* Att vara support till våra hotell vid renoveringar
* Kontaktperson och support till valda konceptarkitekter samt lokala arkitekter
* Att jobba med samt ha kontakt med våra lokala leverantörer och samarbetspartners när det gäller inköp.
* Support och kontaktperson till våra beslutande konceptleverantörer


 Vem vi söker
   

  

**Vi Önskar Att Du Uppfyller Följande Punkter**
* Minst 5 års erfarenhet av inredningsdesign, styling, visuell kommunikation, konceptutveckling eller liknande dekorativa roller.
* Erfarenhet av att arbeta enligt designkoncept och varumärkesstandard.
* Erfarenhet att designa funktionellt utifrån ett kund- och gästperspektiv.
* Erfarenhet av att identifiera och implementera trender inom möbler, belysning och inredningsdesign.
* Kunskap i designprogram som tex. InDesign, Illustrator, Keynote eller liknande
* B-körkort
* Flytande i engelska både i tal och skrift
* God kunskap i svenska eller annat skandinaviskt språk


**Det Är Meriterande Om Du Även**
* Har kunskaper i spanska eller grekiska
* Har kunskaper i AutoCad, SketchUp eller andra ritprogram


 Vi söker dig som tycker om att arbeta ”hands-on” och lösningsorienterat. Du är van eller gillar att jobba med koncept och kan arbeta med en stor variation av stil och trender. Du är effektiv i ditt sätt att arbeta och är flexibel med att skifta mellan olika projekt när arbetet kräver det. Du är kundfokuserad framför allt kring funktionalitet och design. Det är även viktigt att du trivs med att arbeta i grupp och har ett kommunikativt förhållningssätt. Du kommer att arbeta mycket självständigt så vi ser även att du tar egna beslut och driver ditt arbete framåt. Vi lägger stor vikt vid personliga egenskaper.
   

  

**Vi erbjuder**
 Vi erbjuder en spännande och utvecklande miljö där du får en omväxlande vardag tillsammans med härliga kollegor - vi arbetar i nära samarbete mellan de nordiska länderna för att ge våra gäster de bästa veckorna på året. Vi har dessutom ett högt medarbetarengagemang som år efter år visar sig i vår interna medarbetarundersökning. Vi älskar vårt jobb och välkomnar dig ombord på vår resa i Nordic Leisure Travel Group!
   

  

**Övrigt**
**Arbetsplats:** 
 Du utgår från vårt huvudkontor i Stockholm, tjänsten innebär även cirka 75 resdagar per år till våra koncepthotell i Spanien, Cypern, Thailand, Turkiet och Grekland.
   

  

 Vi tillämpar löpande urval vilket innebär att tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag - skicka därmed in din ansökan så snart som möjligt!
   

  

*Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!*
**🏄‍♂️ Kul på jobbet**
**🤝 Tjänstepension**
**🌎 Reseförmåner**
**🦉 Utveckling och lärande**
**💗 Well-being**
**💼 Hybrid arbetsplats**
 Läs mer om vad vi erbjuder här
   

  

 Ving ingår i den nordiska resekoncernen Nordic Leisure Travel Group.
   

  

 I gruppen ingår researrangörerna Ving Sverige, Ving Norge, Globetrotter, Spies i Danmark, Tjäreborg i Finland, flygbolaget Sunclass Airlines samt våra egna hotellkoncept Sunwing Family Resorts, Ocean Beach Club och Sunprime Hotels. Gruppen säljer ett normalt år runt 1 250 000 resor i de nordiska länderna.
   

  

 Product, Hotels & Operations
