title: Solutions Architect, Software and Technology Companies (ISV)
description:
**Description**
 Are you passionate about cloud technology and helping customers innovate?
   

  

 Join our AWS Solutions Architecture team in Sweden and empower Software, SaaS and Technology Companies to innovate at speed and scale with cloud technologies.
   

  

 Solutions Architects work hand in hand with AWS customers to help them make the most of the Cloud. They are at the crossroads of business and technology and engage with organizations at all stages of cloud adoption. Solutions Architects are responsible for creating and presenting technical content and sharing best practices.
   

  

 They work to understand the customer's business needs and give prescriptive guidance on how to create business value with technology. They help customer's validate their initiatives from ideation to proof of concept. Solutions Architects lead activities such as architecture reviews, white-boarding sessions, demos and technical workshops. They collaborate with other teams such as account management, professional services, Industry experts, support, service teams and the AWS partner ecosystem.
   

  

 Amongst others you will be part of the design and building of reference architectures, proof of concepts and help customer deploy production workloads on AWS. You will also provide thought leadership and recommendations on cloud architecture, migration, modernization and operation. Build strong technical relationships acting as the voice of the customer internally to influence AWS service roadmaps.
   

  

 At Amazon you will be encouraged and rewarded for doing what is right for the long-term success of the customer. We value your passion to discover, invent and build on behalf of customers.
   

  

 Amazon has always been, and always will be, committed to diversity and inclusion. We seek builders from all backgrounds to join our teams, and we encourage our employees to bring their authentic, original, and best selves to work.
   

  

 AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and dedicated support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Work directly with strategic customers to accelerate their challenging, mission-critical projects and recommend best-practice architectures in line with their long-term business outcomes
* Build technical relationships with customers and operate as their trusted advisor. The best interests of the customer will shape the guidance you provide.
* Share the voice of the customer to inform the roadmap of AWS features.
* Participate in the creation and sharing of best practices, technical content and new reference architectures (e.g. white papers, code samples, blog posts).
* Evangelise and educate customers about AWS technology (e.g. through workshops, user groups, meetups, public speaking, online videos or conferences).
* Contribute to the growth of the Solutions Architecture organisation by interviewing candidates and having a voice in hiring decisions. You will also be helping others develop new skills by mentoring team members and identifying talent needs in the organisation.
* Develop areas of depth in technical domains relevant to our outcomes.


 A day in the life
   

  

 You will have the opportunity to work with account managers to help customers accelerate their cloud implementation to modernize their business on AWS. Working with these customers, you will help them transform existing workloads by designing modern target architectures optimized for business agility, innovation, performance, resiliency, cost, security, and more using both native and partner solutions.
   

  

 Our teams focus on understanding customer key business drivers as well as the existing application architecture(s) to deliver a technical recommendation to the customer with a goal of designing a robust cloud architecture that can scale as their business requires.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Our Solutions Architecture team empowers innovators to invent on behalf of customers. We are obsessed with understanding each customer's unique objectives to deliver optimal architectures tailored to their needs. Our culture celebrates talented, curious, motivated team members who take ownership of projects. We move with urgency, take risks, learn continuously, and maintain a friendly, inclusive environment. Join our team if you are passionate about technology and delighting customers.
   

  

 Your direct team is located across the Nordics and you would work in close collaboration with team members in Sweden and across borders.
   

  

 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS?
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
   

  

 Mentorship & Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Background in any of the following: Cloud Architecture, Systems Design, Software Development, Infrastructure Architecture, or DevOps
* Technical Degree (Computer Science, Maths, Engineering or equivalent) and/or relevant tech experience.
* Fluent written and verbal communication skills in English
* A passion for technology and for learning


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience designing, building, refactoring or operating IT systems in the cloud
* Working knowledge of software development practices and technologies highly desired
* AWS Certification, eg. AWS Solutions Architect Associate


 Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy\_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.
   

  

 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: A&I - Senior Data Architect
description:
***At FDJ UNITED, we don't just follow the game, we reinvent it.***




  





*FDJ UNITED is one of Europe’s leading betting and gaming operators, with a vast portfolio of iconic brands and a reputation for technological excellence. With more than 5,000 employees and a presence in around fifteen regulated markets, the Group offers a diversified, responsible range of games, both under exclusive rights and open to competition. We set new standards, proving that entertainment and safety can go hand in hand. Here, you’ll work alongside a team of passionate individuals dedicated to delivering the best and safest entertaining experiences for our customers every day.* 




  





*We’re looking for bold people who are eager to succeed and ready to level-up the game. If you thrive on innovation, embrace challenges, and want to make a real impact at all levels, FDJ UNITED is your playing field.* 




  





***Join us in shaping the future of gaming. Are you ready to LEVEL-UP THE GAME?***




  





 As a Senior Data Architect, you will be at the forefront of modernising our A&I (Automation & Insights) data platform architecture and driving operational excellence through automation. You will design cloud-based solutions with both functional (e.g., real-time personalisation) and non-functional (e.g., performance, security, cost control) requirements in mind, ensuring FDJ United remains a leader in the data-driven online gambling industry. Your work will involve shaping lakehouse and data-lake paradigms, leveraging Parquet and Iceberg for high-performance data storage, and adopting scalable Spark frameworks for large-scale processing. Ultimately, you will enable self-service analytics, personalised user experiences, and an AI-first approach to data-driven decision-making.
 



  





**What You’ll Be Doing** 




***Architecting Advanced Data Solutions***



* **Shape End-to-End Data Architectures** 
 : Define conceptual and logical models for data lakes, warehouses, and hybrid deployments (AWS, Azure/Fabric), aligning with key performance and cost objectives.
* **Embed Automation & Monitoring** 
 : Reduce complexity and maximise uptime through DevOps practices, ensuring compliance with FDJ United’s security and regulatory standards.



***Modernising Data Pipelines & Workflows***



* **Implement Scalable Frameworks** 
 : Orchestrate large-scale pipelines using Spark, Docker, Kubernetes, and other DevOps tools.
* **Accelerate Delivery** 
 : Apply standardised processes and automated testing to streamline development and reduce time-to-market while managing terabytes of data daily.



***Driving AI & ML Initiatives***



* **Champion LLMOps & MLOps Strategy** 
 : Set the architectural framework for building, training, and deploying AI/ML models with automation and regulatory compliance in mind.
* **Enhance Operational Efficiency** 
 : Oversee end-to-end workflows (model improvement, versioning, monitoring) to support real-time personalisation and advanced analytics, focusing on architectural integrity rather than hands-on coding.



***Ensuring Governance & Quality***



* **Establish Strong Data Governance** 
 : Partner with the Data Governance Manager to define schema management, metadata frameworks (e.g., OpenMetadata), and data quality controls, promoting data democratisation and self-service.
* **Adhere to Security & Compliance** 
 : Integrate information security standards and FDJ United’s compliance framework into every data process, safeguarding internal and customer data across all stages.



***Collaborative Design & Leadership***



* **Lead Technical Workshops** 
 : Host whiteboard sessions and design reviews, driving shared expertise and open dialogue.
* **Influence Stakeholders** 
 : Translate complex architectural concepts into actionable strategies, aligning with the PAM Enterprise Architect team and TOGAF principles.



***Continuous Innovation & Exploration***



* **Stay Ahead of Trends** 
 : Track emerging data technologies in cloud, DevOps, and AI to maintain a cutting-edge platform.
* **Evaluate & Implement New Solutions** 
 : Prototype and integrate innovations—such as vector databases or advanced real-time analytics—that bring tangible business impact.



  





**What We’re Looking For:** 




***Deep Data Architecture Expertise***



* Proven experience architecting data solutions at enterprise scale (lakehouse concepts, big data platforms, real-time pipelines).
* TOGAF Certified
* Successful track record of optimising cost, performance, and business outcomes under strict compliance requirements.



***Technical Mastery & Hands-On Skills***



* Advanced knowledge of Java/Spring, Python, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS and DevOps methodologies.
* Familiarity with Spark, Iceberg, Parquet, and other solutions for large-scale data processing.



***AI/ML & Analytics Background***



* Competent in ML & analytics, with exposure to LLMOps and MLOps practices (pipeline automation, model governance).
* Comfortable leading the architecture of AI solutions rather than day-to-day model development.



***Governance, Security & Compliance Mindset***



* Skilled in defining and enforcing data governance standards while upholding regulatory and information security best practices.
* Ability to navigate a tough regulatory landscape, ensuring compliance without compromising innovation.



***Excellent Communication & Collaboration***



* Adept at workshop facilitation and bridging technical and non-technical perspectives.
* Self-driven, with a passion for continuous improvement, developer productivity, and accelerating time-to-market.



  





 If you’re excited about applying innovative data architectures, automation, and AI-driven solutions to power one of the world’s largest online gambling groups, we would love to hear from you. Join FDJ United’s A&I Department and help us shape the future of responsible, data-driven entertainment on a global scale.

title: AI Enablement Engineer
description:
Born autonomous. Born electric.
   

  

 Since 2016, our technology has connected global communities with the things they need – and all without the emissions. We’re made up of experts in multiple fields and that’s how we’ve developed a new way to move goods. This is technology purpose-built for the industry. This is safer, cleaner, and more reliable movement.
   

  

 We are Einride and this is how we build a better future.
   

  

 Want to be part of transforming road freight – for good? Einride is showing the world a new way to move, based on the latest digital, electric and autonomous technologies. Through freight capacity as a service, we enable businesses around the world to accelerate towards their sustainability goals.
   

  

 Founded in 2016, Einride became the first company in the world to deploy a cab-less autonomous electric vehicle on a public road (Sweden, 2019). In 2022, we were the first to successfully operate such a vehicle on a US public road. Today our award-winning technology has been launched across 8 countries (and counting). Our clients are some of the world’s biggest shippers, including Fortune 500 companies. We are also operating Sweden’s largest truck dedicated public charging network and counting.
   

  

 As an
 **AI Enablement Engineer** 
 at Einride, you will bridge the gap between our business operations and modern AI technologies. You will empower teams across the organization to build, deploy, and manage secure AI workflows by helping identify high-impact use cases and mentoring them on secure development, prompt design, and context handling. You will also collaborate closely with our Platform Engineering team to design the underlying cloud infrastructure and security guardrails required for these workflows.
   

  

**You Will**
* Partner with less technical business stakeholders to understand their pain points, identify high-impact AI use cases and structure business knowledge as context for AI tools.
* Work with our Platform Engineering team to design and build cloud infrastructure that makes it easy to develop, deploy, maintain, and monitor AI workflows.
* Establish best practices for data privacy, model governance, autonomous agents and human-in-the-loop validation to ensure internal AI solutions are secure and reliable.
* Coach and mentor colleagues across varying levels of technical expertise.


**We Expect You To**
* Be service-minded, a good communicator and enjoy supporting colleagues with different levels of technical expertise.
* Have experience with a general-purpose programming language such as Python, Java, or Go, and working knowledge of cloud infrastructure concepts.
* Have a solid understanding of secure software development and data privacy.
* Have practical experience with prompt engineering, business context structuring, and model output validation.


 This is a full-time position based in Stockholm or Gothenburg. You will be part of a truly diverse, high performing team with a common passion for sustainability and making things happen in an innovative way. We recommend that you submit your application as soon as possible since selection and interviews are held continually.
   

  

 At Einride, we are innovators, building solutions the world has never seen before – but urgently needs. That’s why we take action, and it’s why we are always eager to be challenged. We know that our best innovations come from having a diverse mix of people, including those of different experiences, career paths, and walks of life. By coming together and sharing our perspectives openly – by disagreeing, discussing, and committing – we deliver greater impact.
   

  

**Please note:** 
 Our recruitment process includes an online candidate assessment via Alva Labs and a standard background check prior to employment.

title: Systemarkitekt
description:
Vi söker en senior systemarkitekt för ett konsultuppdrag hos en stor svensk myndighet. Uppdraget har planerad start i september 2026 och pågår till 30 juni 2027.
 



  





 Du kommer in i en organisation med ett starkt fokus på digitalisering och effektivisering av interna processer. Målet är att skapa långsiktiga, säkra och robusta IT-lösningar som förenklar medarbetarnas vardag och minskar administrativa moment.
 



  





**Om uppdraget** 




 Som systemarkitekt får du en central roll i organisationens fortsatta utveckling av sina arkitekturförmågor och sin arkitekturstyrning. IT-miljön omfattar ett 40-tal system och tjänster med en kombination av standardsystem, molntjänster och egenutvecklade produkter.
 



 Du arbetar nära andra arkitekter, utvecklingsteam och tågledning inom en SAFe-baserad utvecklingsorganisation.
 



  





 Rollen innebär bland annat att:
 


* Omsätta verksamhetsbehov till hållbara och optimerade IT-lösningar.
* Ta fram, bereda och presentera lösningsförslag inför tekniska beslut och förändringar.
* Säkerställa att arkitekturprinciper, architectural runway, enablers och icke-funktionella krav implementeras och kommuniceras.
* Fungera som tekniskt och arkitekturellt bollplank för verksamhet och utvecklingsteam.
* Bidra till utvecklingen av organisationens arkitekturstyrning.
* Vid behov coacha och genomföra kunskapsöverföring till andra arkitekter.
* Samverka med ett stort antal interna och externa intressenter.



  





**Vi söker dig som har** 



* Minst 8 års aktuell arbetslivserfarenhet som IT-arkitekt i en stor organisation med minst 3 000 medarbetare.



  





**Meriterande erfarenhet:** 



* Arkitektur för interna stödsystem inom exempelvis HR, ekonomi eller verksamhetsstyrning.
* Agila utvecklingsmiljöer enligt SAFe.
* Applikationsutveckling med exempelvis Spring Boot och React.
* Containerbaserade plattformar såsom OpenShift Container Platform.
* Integrationer via exempelvis API och batchlösningar.
* Arkitektur inom ServiceNow, exempelvis Service Portal, App Engine och HRSD.



  





**Som person** 




 För att lyckas i uppdraget ser vi att du är lösningsorienterad, strukturerad och har en god analytisk förmåga. Du trivs med att samarbeta med olika kompetenser och intressenter och kan förklara komplexa tekniska lösningar på ett tydligt och pedagogiskt sätt, både muntligt och skriftligt.
 



 Du behöver även kunna se helheten, identifiera mönster och samtidigt göra relevanta avgränsningar för att driva arkitekturarbetet framåt.
 



  





**Din ansökan** 




 Låter rollen intressant och passande? Ansök i så fall omgående för vi intervjuar löpande och rollen kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum. Vi kan enbart ta emot och bearbeta din ansökan genom att du registrerar ditt CV i vår portal. Med avseende på GDPR kan vi ej ta emot ansökningar via e-post. Varmt välkommen med din ansökan! Uppdraget är en del av Quest Consulting personaluthyrning.
 



  





**Om oss** 




 Quest Consulting är ett auktoriserat konsultbolag med kollektivavtal, försäkringar, friskvård och tjänstepension. Vi är specialiserade inom IT, Teknik, HR, Administration och Ekonomi. Vår målsättning är att vara din personliga samarbetspartner och just därför är det så viktigt för oss att arbeta efter våra kärnvärden där våra ledord är att vara Personliga, Nyskapande och Professionella

title: M365 Security Engineer
description:
**Please note that due to the summer holiday period, our recruitment process may take a little longer than usual. We look forward to reviewing your application and will provide an update in August.**
 At Viaplay Group, we entertain millions of people every day through our streaming services, radio networks, and TV channels. We believe in the power of content not just as a way of telling stories and touching lives, but also expanding worlds.
   

  

 We’re looking for the best people to join us on our journey. Right now, we’re searching for a
 **M365 Security Engineer** 
 in our
 **Stockholm** 
 office – are you ready to hit play on an exciting career change?
   

  

**The Role**
 We are seeking an experienced M365 Security Engineer to join our IT Workplace team, working as a core team member with shared responsibility and close, hands‑on collaboration across all areas of IT. You will support security operations, governance, and compliance within an outsourced, Microsoft‑based hybrid IT environment.
   

  

 The role is responsible for protecting the organisation against cyber threats and embedding security best practices across the Group. You will work closely with colleagues and an outsourced IT partner to deliver effective and pragmatic security outcomes.
   

  

 You will act as a technical lead for security operations, incident response, and security tooling, working collaboratively rather than in isolation, and ensuring security is integrated into day‑to‑day IT operations and change initiatives.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Act as a security lead for IT modernisation and improvement initiatives
* Work with the SOC partner to monitor, investigate, and respond to security alerts and incidents across cloud, on‑premises, and SaaS environments
* Act as the technical escalation point for high‑priority security incidents, coordinating containment, remediation, and recovery activities
* Perform root cause analysis and post‑incident reviews, communicating risks and outcomes to both technical and non‑technical stakeholders.
* Administer and operate security tooling, primarily Microsoft Purview, Defender, and Entra
* Design and manage the implementation of Zero Trust controls utilising Conditional Access, PIM, RBAC, and identity governance
* Maintain and improve security policies, ensuring alignment with recognised standards and regulatory requirements such as ISO 27001 and NIS2
* Support vulnerability management activities, audits, penetration testing, and third‑party risk assessments
* Produce incident, threat, and compliance reporting for stakeholders
* Drive continuous improvement of security controls, tooling, and processes


**What We’re Looking For**
 We understand you may feel confident ticking certain boxes more than others and that’s why we always keep an open mind in our recruitment process. But, in order to thrive in this role, we do believe you’ll have at least some experience in the following:
   

  

* 5+ years’ experience in cybersecurity or security operations roles
* Hands‑on experience with Microsoft Purview, Defender, Entra, and vulnerability and threat management tools.
* Experience working with outsourced IT services and SOC partners

title: Senior Delivery Consultant – Data
description:
**Description**
 The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Delivery Consultant to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you'll work closely with customers to design, implement, and manage AWS solutions that meet their technical requirements and business objectives. You'll be a key player in driving customer success through their cloud journey, providing technical expertise and best practices throughout the project lifecycle.
   

  

 Possessing a deep understanding of AWS products and services, as a Delivery Consultant you will be proficient in architecting complex, scalable, and secure solutions tailored to meet the specific needs of each customer. You’ll work closely with stakeholders to gather requirements, assess current infrastructure, and propose effective migration strategies to AWS. As trusted advisors to our customers, providing guidance on industry trends, emerging technologies, and innovative solutions, you will be responsible for leading the implementation process, ensuring adherence to best practices, optimizing performance, and managing risks throughout the project.
   

  

 The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 As an experienced technology professional, you will be responsible for:
   

  

* Designing and implementing complex, scalable, and secure AWS solutions tailored to customer needs
* Providing technical guidance and troubleshooting support throughout project delivery
* Collaborating with stakeholders to gather requirements and propose effective migration strategies
* Acting as a trusted advisor to customers on industry trends and emerging technologies
* Sharing knowledge within the organization through mentoring, training, and creating reusable artifacts


**About The Team**
 Diverse Experiences: AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job below, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture - Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
   

  

 Mentorship & Career Growth - We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance - We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 5+ years of experience in cloud architecture and implementation, Alternative: Experience in cloud architecture and implementation
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, related field, or equivalent experience
* Data lake architecture and design (Lake Formation, S3-based architectures)
* Medallion architecture implementation (bronze/silver/gold layer design)
* Data strategy and governance frameworks
* Data modeling and schema design for analytics workloads and modern data platform design and implementation
* ETL/ELT pipeline development and optimization (Glue, EMR)
* Data warehousing solutions (Redshift) and Data catalog management and metadata governance and Big data processing platforms (EMR, Glue)
* Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent experience, in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics or a related field
* 8+ years of experience of IT platform implementation in a highly technical and analytical role.
* 5+ years’ experience of Data Lake/Hadoop platform implementation, including 3+ years of hands-on experience in implementation and performance tuning Hadoop/Spark implementations
* Ability to think strategically about business, product, and technical challenges in an enterprise environment.
* Experience with analytic solutions applied to the Marketing or Risk needs of enterprises


**Preferred Qualifications**
* AWS experience preferred, with proficiency in a wide range of AWS services (e.g., EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, IAM, VPC, CloudFormation)
* AWS Professional level certifications (e.g., Solutions Architect Professional, DevOps Engineer Professional) preferred
* Experience with automation and scripting (e.g., Terraform, Python)
* Knowledge of security and compliance standards (e.g., HIPAA, GDPR)
* Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences
* Understanding of database and analytical technologies in the industry including MPP and NoSQL databases, Data Warehouse design, BI reporting and Dashboard development.
* Implementation and tuning experience specifically using Amazon Elastic Map Reduce (EMR).

title: Global Solutions Architect, Automotive & Manufacturing, Automotive&Manufacturing EMEA SA
description:
**Description**
 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for experienced and motivated technologists who possess a unique balance of technical depth and strong interpersonal skills. You will partner some of the worlds largest Automotive and Manufacturing companies, to craft highly scalable, flexible and resilient cloud architectures that address customer business problems and accelerate the adoption of AWS services. In collaboration with account managers, you will assist in driving growth across a set of global customers in your defined country. As a trusted customer advocate, the solutions architect will help organizations understand best practices around advanced cloud-based solutions, and how to migrate existing workloads to the cloud. You will have the opportunity to help shape and execute a strategy to build mind share and broad use of AWS within enterprise customers. The ability to connect technology with measurable business value is critical to a solutions architect. You should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically about business, products, and technical challenges.
   

  

**Here Are Some Other Qualities We Are Looking For**
 Be great fun to work with.
   

  

 At AWS, we have a credo of “Work hard. Have fun. Make history”. In this role, you will love what you do, and instinctively know how to make work fun. You will be dynamic and creative, and willing to take on any challenge and make a big impact.
   

  

 Enjoy working with large, global customers. You will have a passion for educating, training, designing, and building cloud solutions for a diverse and challenging set of enterprise customers.
   

  

 Have a strong understanding of large scale computing solutions. The ideal candidate will have past experience working as a systems or support engineer. You will enjoy keeping your existing technical skills honed and developing new ones, so you can make strong contributions to deep architecture discussions. You will regularly take part in deep-dive education and design exercises to create world-class solutions built on AWS.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Serve as a trusted technical and AI advisor to customers, understanding their business needs and technology challenges to architect customized solutions
* Lead discussions to shape a customer's long-term technology and AI strategy and guide them on trade-offs between short-term fixes and extensible, scalable solutions
* Design end-to-end solutions leveraging both technical expertise and business acumen, driving consensus across multiple teams to deliver impactful solutions
* Proactively identify opportunities to accelerate implementation through reusable components, parallel workstreams, etc.
* Share knowledge by developing technical content like sample code, presentations, workshops to exemplify best practices and educate customers
* Drive product innovation by gathering customer feedback, translating needs into clear requirements, and partnering with product teams through development
* Resolve complex technical problems through root cause analysis, both for customers and internally
* Contribute strategic planning, recruiter/develop talent, build team consensus, and provide guidance to more junior solutions architects


 A day in the life
   

  

* Review customer requirements and technical challenges, focusing on opportunities to implement complex solutions architectures that can transform business outcomes also leveraging AI capabilities
* Develop proof-of-concepts that demonstrate how cloud solutions can transform business processes
* Influence service team leadership and product marketing on the future needs for customers, prioritizing roadmap features and GTM messaging
* Dedicate time to continuous learning about the latest advancements in AWS service capabilities
* Participate in knowledge sharing activities with colleagues, creating field enablement materials to help other SAs understand how to integrate cloud solutions into customer architectures


**About The Team**
 The AWS Industries team is committed to helping industry customers enable their digital transformation journeys. Our primary goal is to meet customers in their cloud and AI journey and work backwards from their industry-specific needs to transform their businesses and industries. Our team focuses on business outcomes and industry use cases on behalf of our customers, whether that is how we build products and solutions, how we sell, how we deliver, or how we partner.
   

  

 The Automotive & Manufacturing Solutions Architecture team is dedicated to accelerating AWS cloud adoption across strategic automotive and manufacturing accounts. Our mission is to drive tangible business value through focused execution on strategic projects, while enabling scale by up-skilling broader field teams. We work at the intersection of technology and industry-specific transformation, partnering closely with account teams, technology specialists, and industry specialist teams to deliver comprehensive solutions.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent, or experience in a professional field or military
* Experience in IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries
* Experience within specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics).
* Experience in design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures
* Experience communicating across technical and non-technical audiences, including executive level stakeholders or clients
* Cloud Computing


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in infrastructure architecture, database architecture and networking
* Experience working with end user or developer communities
* Experience with presentations and speaking with executives, IT, management, and developers
* Automotive domain expertise

 Job ID: A10408343

title: Lead AI Engineer
description:
**Who We Are**


We are a well-funded, early-stage technology company on a mission to fundamentally redefine the way the world searches, discovers, and transacts, built on a philosophy that puts the user first at every step.

  

The user is not simply a means of transaction. They are a valued participant whose data works for them, not against them, enriching their world and their own experience within it, with them retaining full control.

  

Our mission is underpinned by proprietary, patent-pending technology built on a novel engine and system.

**The Problem You Will Be Solving**


The internet was built to inform the many, not to serve the individual. Platforms optimize for engagement, extraction, and consumption at global scale. AI has made this model even more efficient, with the user still largely remaining the input, not the full beneficiary.

  

The problem is not information. The world has never had more. The problem is that people give away a lifetime of data without receiving the personalized experience it should enable.

  

People should not have to search. They should simply find.

**Who You Are**


Highly talented and motivated to build products with people, for people


You thrive in zero-to-one environments and find genuine satisfaction in creating from scratch


A fast-paced thinker with a relentless desire to learn, improve, and raise the standard around you


Able to inspire, elevate, and collaborate; you make the people around you better


A great communicator; you express complex ideas with clarity, precision, and confidence across all levels of the organization


Able to transform ideas into working systems and technical milestones with light speed and precision


Highly ambitious and action-driven; you thrive under pressure and find genuine energy in working at the edge of what is considered possible


Capable of designing and building production-grade systems in a fourth of the time most experienced and “sane” professionals would consider possible

**What You Will Do**


Design end-to-end machine learning architectures, including data pipelines, feature engineering, model training, real-time serving, and evaluation systems


Build scalable personalization and relevance systems that process high-volume, sequential behavioral data in real time to power context-aware content delivery at scale


Develop high-velocity model training pipelines capable of learning from large-scale heterogeneous datasets, enabling rapid experimentation while maintaining production-grade rigor and reliability


Design and operate low-latency model serving infrastructure that supports seamless version rollouts, traffic management, and feature transitions with zero user-visible disruption


Create comprehensive experimentation and evaluation platforms, combining offline metrics, online A/B testing, and integrated tooling to provide continuous, data-driven visibility into platform improvements


Establish ML engineering standards around code quality, reproducibility, monitoring, and incident response that will be inherited by the broader engineering team

**Minimum Qualifications**


MSc in Machine Learning, Computer Science, Statistics, or a directly related quantitative field from KTH, Chalmers, ETH Zurich, EPFL, or an institution of equivalent standing


3 or more years of industry experience designing and shipping production ML systems at scale; architectures you originated, not contributed to


Demonstrated experience working in or alongside early-stage, fast-moving technology companies; you understand what it means to build without a safety net


Deep expertise in at least two of: large-scale personalization, recommendation and ranking systems, sequential behavioral modelling, real-time ML serving, or privacy-preserving ML at the architecture level


Production software engineering discipline that extends well beyond model code; you design the systems beneath the ML layer, not only the models on top of it


Exceptional candidates with fewer years of industry experience will be considered where their research output, published work, or demonstrated systems constitute an equivalent body of evidence

**Preferred Qualifications**


PhD in Machine Learning, Computer Science, or a directly related field; given significant weight in our assessment


Prior experience as a technical lead, staff engineer, or principal engineer at a high-growth technology company or research institution


Background from a company known for world-class ML systems; Spotify, Klarna, Google, Meta, OpenAI, DeepMind or comparable


Research publications or substantive independent technical work in relevant technical areas


A track record of delivering complete, production-quality ML systems at a pace that clearly distinguishes you from peers

**What We Offer**


Expect the most talented, rigorous, and driven colleagues you have worked with; people who lift each other up and hold each other to the highest standard. This company is driven by ideas and innovation, regardless of age, position, or background. The best ideas must win and the people behind them recognized and rewarded.

  

A home for exceptional people and geniuses within their domain; those who have always known what they are capable of and have been waiting for the environment to prove it to the world, whilst first being seen and supported by their coworkers.

  

Compensation includes an attractive salary and meaningful equity ownership for an early-stage startup.

**Equal Opportunity**


We are an equal opportunity employer committed to building an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work and reach their full potential. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

**Application**


To apply, send your CV/resume, GitHub profile, LinkedIn profile, and a brief note on how and why you would like to contribute to our mission. Upon initial acceptance, an in-person interview will follow shortly in Stockholm, Sweden.

  

Please note that all applications and interviews are conducted in English. Fluency in written and spoken English is a requirement for all roles.

  

All applications are treated with strict confidentiality.

title: Test Engineer
description:
ALTEN is expanding its presence in the automotive industry and we are now looking for a Test Engineer to join our team. If you have a passion for quality, technology, and innovative vehicles, this is a great opportunity to work at the forefront of automotive R&D.

  

Your role


As a Test Engineer at ALTEN, you will play a key role in ensuring the functionality, performance, and quality of complex automotive systems. You will work in close collaboration with cross-functional teams to test and verify electronic, software, and mechatronic systems in modern vehicles.


Your main responsibilities will include:


* Planning, designing, and executing manual and automated test cases
* Performing regression, system, and functional testing in HIL, SIL, and/or vehicle environments
* Troubleshooting and analyzing test results, reporting issues to development teams
* Collaborating with developers, system engineers, and project managers to ensure high-quality deliveries
* Developing and improving test methods and automation frameworks
* Conducting in-vehicle testing with precision and attention to detail
Your profile


You have a relevant technical education (e.g. B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Electronics, Mechatronics, Computer Science, or similar) and a few years of experience working with testing or verification of complex systems, preferably in the automotive field.

  

You bring:


* Experience in manual and automated testing
* Knowledge of regression and system testing
* Ability to design and maintain test cases independently
* Hands-on experience with tools such as Jenkins and Python (or similar)
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills in HIL/SIL/vehicle environments
* Excellent English communication skills, written and spoken
* A valid Swedish or EU driver’s license (vehicle testing may be part of the job)
* Previous experience within the automotive industry
  

Meritorious Experience


* Background in test automation and scripting
* Knowledge of automotive communication protocols (CAN, LIN, FlexRay, Ethernet)
* Experience with requirement management tools (SystemWeaver, DOORS, Polarion, or similar)
**About ALTEN**

title: Product Manager | Capacity & Conversion
description:
Instabee is building the future of parcel delivery in the Nordics — smarter, more flexible, and centered around what actually works for people's lives. Ever wondered how millions of parcels find their way into exactly the right locker, at exactly the right moment? That's the puzzle our Capacity & Conversion team solves every day.
  
About the role
  
As Product Manager for Capacity & Conversion, you'll lead the strategy behind matching users to a delightful delivery journey, while making sure our locker capacity is used as efficiently as possible. Capacity is one of the core challenges at Instabee: your team ensures we offer the right shipment destinations at the right time, keeping conversion rates high while delivering on our promise of a fast, uncomplicated experience for both customers and merchants.
  
This role is about driving business impact — understanding ecommerce logic and consumer behavior, and solving complex trade-offs between loyalty, parcel volume, and operational constraints. If you thrive on turning ambiguous, complex challenges into clear, high-impact product strategies that move real-world numbers, this is the role for you.
  
  

**Some of the things you'll do:**  

Identify and define the challenges in your area with the highest potential for impact
  
  

Break down company-wide and business area goals into actionable work
  
  

Prioritize activities based on their potential to move our North Star metric, investing resources in validating the most promising opportunities and supporting cross-team bets to success
  
  

Build the roadmap, secure buy-in from stakeholders, and navigate the path to successful outcomes
  
  

Your future team
  
You'll join a tight-knit team within our Network business area — PMs, decision analysts, and business leaders who collaborate across departments, bring clarity to ambiguity, and value real-world impact over theoretical perfection. Curiosity, humility, and a strong drive to make things better are what bring us together. The product team you'll lead consists of highly skilled software engineers, machine learning experts, and data scientists, supported by an Engineering Manager and Staff Engineer as your co-leads.
  
What we're looking for
  
We're looking for a true leader and relationship-builder with a strong sense of ownership — someone equally comfortable leading strategic conversations with senior leadership as they are breaking down complex data into actionable insights. With strong business acumen, analytical skills, and a bias toward impact, you know how to prioritize ruthlessly and keep teams focused on what matters most.
  
  

Proven success as a Product Manager, or in an equivalent role, in a fast-paced environment
  
  

Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to bring people along on a vision
  
  

Curious and analytical, guided equally by data and business intuition
  
  

A natural leader who motivates, sets clear expectations, and leads with trust rather than tasks, generating real-world impact at high speed
  
  

Ability to articulate the vision for the team and for a wide range of stakeholders, from senior executives to highly specialized technical experts
  
  

**The cherry on top:**  

Impact-driven and pragmatic — you care about outcomes, not output
  
  

Able to simplify complexity, prioritize ruthlessly, and act with conviction
  
  

Structured, decisive, and resilient in the face of uncertainty
  
  

Energized by ownership and motivated to build for the future
  
  

What you'll get
  
We can promise you'll be challenged, grow your skills, and get to work alongside truly talented colleagues. If you like driving change and shaping new ways of working, this is the place for you.
  
Of course, we offer all the standard benefits — but on top of that, you'll also get:
  
**Sky-High Office:** A modern, newly renovated space with a 360-degree view over Stockholm
  
**Puppy Friendly:** Bring your dog to work — we've got a whole floor for our furry friends!
  
**Fun & Games:** Ping pong, shuffleboard, foosball, even a karaoke room!
  
**Parental Pay:** Six months of paid leave to spend time with your little one
  
**Birthday Day Off:** Celebrate your birthday with a well-earned break
  
**⏰ Flexible Hours:** A hybrid setup with hours that work with your life
  
As part of our commitment to maintaining a safe and trustworthy workplace, all candidates applying to Instabee in Sweden will undergo a background check conducted by Svensk Bakgrundsanalys. This review examines public criminal records and is a mandatory step in our recruitment process. While the results are public information, we handle all data with the utmost confidentiality.
  
If building systems that bridge the digital and physical worlds sounds like your kind of challenge, we'd love to hear from you!

title: Enterprise Solutions Engineer - Sweden
description:
**About ElevenLabs**
--------------------


ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.


We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B - multiples of 11, always.  

  

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

* ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.
* ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.
* ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.


Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

**How we work**
---------------

* **High-velocity:** Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.
* **Impact not job titles:** We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.
* **AI first:** We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.
* **Excellence everywhere:** Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.
* **Global team:** We prioritize your talent, not your location.

**What we offer**
-----------------

* **Innovative culture:** You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
* **Growth paths:** Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.
* **Learning & development**: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.
* **Social travel**: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.
* **Annual company offsite:** Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.
* **Co-working**: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

**About the role**
------------------


As a Solutions Engineer, you'll work as part of a driven team to unlock the full potential of our voice AI platform for a growing customer base. Your mission is to efficiently scale our technical solutions to many enterprise customers, both directly and by improving our internal processes and supporting our sales teams.


As a Solutions Engineer, you can expect to:

* Collaborate strategically with Account Executives to enhance the technical aspects of the sales process.
* Work directly with technical contacts from our customers and prospective customers to provide bespoke support and architect solutions.
* Craft compelling technical demonstrations that clearly communicate our product's value proposition.
* Create technical enablement resources that amplify our sales team's effectiveness and technical fluency.
* Build self-service tools and documentation that empower customers to implement solutions independently.
* Identify opportunities to productize common integration patterns or features, and work with our product teams to make these real!

**Requirements**
----------------


We're looking for exceptional individuals who excel at working with customers on technical problems and excited to work with us to scale this efficiently. You'll thrive with us if you:

* Are passionate about AI, technology and ElevenLabs products.
* Enjoy working directly with customers, iterating on solutions and providing tailored support
* Have a talent for identifying patterns that can be standardized and scaled.
* Have strong empathy for customers, sales and product teams.
* Have a strong technical background in order to help customers architect integration between our solutions and their existing solutions
* Experience working with customers. It’s ok if you only worked with customers in student clubs or side projects, as long as you are interested in working closely with them on a technical capacity
* Proficiency in Python, inclusive of a deep understanding of software development, software architecture, and common integration patterns.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to adapt messaging to different audiences.


We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

title: Full-stack Software Engineer
description:
**About us** 




 Ingrid was born out of a simple belief: the energy transition must move faster and work smarter. We're pioneers at the forefront of the global energy transition — pushing boundaries, turning bold ideas into reality, and solving the problems that matter most.
 



  





 The INtelligent GRID of tomorrow needs to absorb and release more power. We develop, build and operate high-performance batteries — the lungs of modern energy infrastructure — enabling a more flexible and resilient energy supply across Europe. With 500 MW already deployed across the Nordics and rapid expansion into continental Europe, we manage, optimise and trade both our own assets and those of third parties through our sophisticated tech platform, making every battery — and the entire grid — stronger.
 



  





**Watch our film** 




  





**About the role** 




 Software and smart solutions are at the core of how we tackle the toughest bottlenecks in the power system. Our Ingrid Technology team builds and maintains the platform that powers real-time trading decisions, grid balancing, asset optimisation, and the data pipelines that keep our operations sharp. The systems we build run at scale, interact with live energy markets, and directly influence the stability of the grid.
 



  





 We're looking for a Software Engineer to join the Platforms team - a group that owns the Cloud, Data, and Applications platforms. You'll work across the full stack with the only limit being your own curiosity and ambition.
 



  





 This is a hands-on engineering role in a fast-moving environment. You'll have real ownership over what you build, collaborate closely with colleagues across trading, market intelligence, and asset operations. You’ll deploy often and see your impact quickly.
 



  





**What you'll do** 



* Apply your skills to one of our key domains. Optimization & Trade, Delivery & Steering, or the Partner Apply your skills to one of our key domains. Optimization & Trade, Delivery & Steering, or the Partner Experience Platform – and grow with it as we scale.
* Design, build and maintain production-grade services across the stack. Backend in Python (FastAPI, Pydantic, SQLModel/SQLAlchemy) and frontend in TypeScript, React and Node.js – deployed as containerised microservices in the cloud, backed by PostgreSQL, Redis and BigQuery.
* Build the interfaces where the platform meets its users. Traders, asset operators and partners act on what you build – a well-structured UI on live data is as much part of the craft as the service behind it.
* Contribute to API design, architecture and the tech roadmap. RESTful and event-driven patterns, with security, auth and observability built in from the start – not as an afterthought.



  





**Your background** 



* Solid Python experience. Comfort building production services with modern tooling – FastAPI or equivalent, type-safe patterns with Pydantic or similar.
* Frontend experience in TypeScript/React for both external end-users and internal tooling.
* Cloud platform experience in GCP or other with a curiosity to learn. An understanding of CI/CD, containerisation (Docker), and how services are deployed and monitored in production.
* Experience with the energy sector is a bonus, but not required. We'll get you up to speed on the domain.
* AI-native and genuinely keen on modern AI tooling, using it to sharpen your own workflow and helping colleagues get the most out of theirs.



  





**Your personal skills** 




 In addition to your qualifications we believe that below skills will make you a star in the Ingrid Tech team:
 


* Solution-oriented with ability to focus on finding practical solutions balancing speed and technical debt effectively.
* Curious and a natural inclination to explore new technologies, methodologies, and approaches, driving continuous improvement; actively seizing opportunities and taking initiative.
* Flexible in fast-paced start-up environment and willingness to test ideas, fail fast and take on new tasks when needed.



  





**Why join us?** 




 At Ingrid, we're pioneers at the forefront of the global energy transition — pushing boundaries, turning bold ideas into reality, and solving what matters most. Our culture is built on Bold Impact · Curious Grit · Inspiring Collaboration. We believe a thriving organisation runs on trust, growth, and learning from mistakes — and that wellbeing matters as much as work. From lunch & learns to social activities, we make space to connect, recharge, and thrive together.
 



  





**Next step** 




 We’ll make selections on an ongoing basis and finalise the recruitment as soon as we’ve found the perfect match. This process will run over summer vacations and we will keep everyone involved updated on our expected timeline.
 



  





 We look forward to hearing from you!
 



 /Team Ingrid

title: Senior Frontend Lead Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
**DigitalRoute is the company behind how the digital world gets paid.** 
 For over 25 years, we've turned massive, complex usage data into trusted, finance-grade information that enterprises rely on to bill, price, and grow. Today, more than 400 companies across SaaS, AI, cloud, media, and telecom run their revenue-critical data through our platform with precision to the cent and zero downtime.
   

  

 And the timing couldn't be better. The entire digital economy is moving away from static subscriptions toward usage- and outcome-based pricing over 75% of new digital products will price this way by 2028. That shift makes what we do essential infrastructure for every business that wants to compete. Our customers reach market 2x faster, grow 4x quicker, and cut revenue leakage by more than half. This is a company where your work has real impact and we're just getting started.
   

  

 We’re now rebuilding our Usage Engine platform. It’s a ground-up, Kubernetes-native, streaming-first data mediation engine with a completely new user experience.
   

  

 The frontend is central to the product. It’s a Svelte single-page application where engineers design, inspect, and debug pipelines that process billions of usage records every day. Think visual workflow editor, keyboard-first interactions, dense tables, deep links everywhere, and a product that needs to feel more like a desktop engineering tool than a web form.
   

  

 As Senior Frontend Lead Engineer, you’ll own the application, its architecture, its standards, and how it grows. This is a rare greenfield rewrite where the frontend is treated as a core part of the platform.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Lead the design and build of a demanding web application: a graph-based workflow editor with automatic layout using d3 and ELK, embedded code editing with CodeMirror 6, custom language support, diff and merge views, dense data tables, and operational views built for speed.
* Own the frontend architecture and technical direction for a Svelte 5, SvelteKit, TypeScript SPA built with Vite. That includes component structure, state and reactivity patterns, rendering performance, accessibility, and the engineering standards the team works by.
* Connect deeply with the platform’s REST APIs, served by a Vert.x backend, OIDC-based authentication, and a GitOps-native configuration model where every artifact edited in the UI is a version-controlled file, and merging to main deploys it.
* Shape how AI-assisted features show up in the product. The platform includes pipeline copilots, anomaly detection, and self-healing pipelines. The frontend is where users actually meet those features, so the interaction design matters.
* Own quality with the team. We use Vitest and Testing Library for unit and component tests, Playwright for end-to-end tests, svelte-check for type safety, and CI gates that block code that doesn’t meet the bar.
* Work closely with PMs, product owners, UX, backend teams, and the CTO office. The users are highly technical, so part of the job is turning their needs into clear frontend decisions.
* Guide the team through design discussions, hands-on code review, and strong pull request habits. We use GitHub, CI gates, and CODEOWNERS.
* Use AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code and GitHub Copilot as part of your workflow, and help the team use them well.
* Stay close to the Svelte ecosystem and the wider frontend field, bringing in tools and patterns only when they genuinely help.


**What You'll Bring**
* Experience as a frontend architect or lead frontend engineer on complex, data-heavy applications. Developer tools, IDEs, visual editors, monitoring products, observability tools, or similar products are the right kind of background. Content-heavy websites are less relevant here.
* Deep hands-on experience with TypeScript and modern component frameworks. Strong Svelte experience is a big plus, especially Svelte 5 and runes-based reactivity. If you come from React or Vue and want to go deep on Svelte, we’d still like to talk.
* Experience building interactive canvas or graph-based interfaces. Dragging, zooming, selection, automatic layout, large datasets, frequent updates — you know where these interfaces get hard, and how to keep them fast.
* Comfort with embedded editor tooling such as CodeMirror or similar tools, including syntax highlighting, linting, autocomplete, and diff or merge views.
* Strong knowledge of the modern frontend toolchain: Vite, npm, GitHub Actions, CI/CD, and shipping SPAs for SaaS or Kubernetes-deployed products.
* A strong testing mindset. Vitest unit coverage and Playwright end-to-end tests are part of your normal definition of done.
* Hands-on development skills. You still write code, and you can demonstrate, build, review, and improve the application yourself.
* Practical experience with AI coding assistants in professional development, plus curiosity about where they can genuinely improve frontend engineering.
* Clear communication, strong teamwork, and comfort collaborating across teams, disciplines, and time zones.
* Bonus: experience with OIDC or OAuth flows, gRPC or Protobuf-backed systems, enterprise or telecom-grade software, or LLM-backed product features.


**Why this role**
 You’ll join a focused Stockholm and Gothenburg-based team rebuilding the heart of a proven product for the next decade. This is a clean-room rewrite, guided by real production workloads and clear engineering standards. The frontend is not a layer on top. It is one of the main ways users understand, trust, and operate the platform. The team is small enough that your decisions will shape the product. The company is established enough that what you build will be used by serious enterprise customers in production.
   

  

 We follow a continuous selection process, and the position may be filled before the last application date.
   

  

 DigitalRoute is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse environment, and we actively encourage qualified candidates of all genders, sexual orientations, ethnicities, disabilities, and ages to apply. Join our global and diverse company, where our differences are our strengths.

title: Backend Engineer, Berlin
description:
**About Air Apps**
 At Air Apps, we believe in thinking bigger—and moving faster. We’re a family-founded company on a mission to create the world’s first AI-powered Personal & Entrepreneurial Resource Planner (PRP), and we need your passion and ambition to help us change how people plan, work, and live. Born in Lisbon, Portugal in 2018—and now with offices in both Lisbon and San Francisco—we’ve remained self-funded while reaching over 100 million downloads worldwide.
   

  

 Our long-term focus drives us to challenge the status quo every day, pushing the boundaries of AI-driven solutions that truly make a difference. Here, you’ll be a creative force, shaping products that empower people across the globe.
   

  

 Join us on this journey to redefine resource management—and change lives along the way.
   

  

**The Role**
 As a Backend Software Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining the server-side components of our applications. You will collaborate closely with product managers, frontend developers, and other cross-functional teams to deliver robust and scalable backend services that power critical features and support rapid growth.
   

  

* This is a fully onsite position, based at our office in Lisbon, where you will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams in person and contribute to a dynamic and fast-paced environment. We are open to support with relocation efforts.


**Responsibilities**
* API & Service Architecture - Design and build RESTful or GraphQL APIs, microservices, and business logic using Node.js and TypeScript.
* Database Design & Integration - Model data and manage queries using Supabase and PostgreSQL, including functions, row-level security, and real-time features.
* Cloud Infrastructure - Deploy and manage services on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), particularly with Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, IAM, and Pub/Sub.
* Code Quality & Testing - Write clean, testable code using unit, integration, and end-to-end testing frameworks (e.g., Jest). Contribute to code reviews and quality assurance practices.
